records.plant_name: Monarch Rock Air data center campus (Rockford)
records.monitor_reason: Closed on October 30, 2026: the air permit names twenty gas engines of 12.37 MW each, and the plant is added in this batch as the Milkweed Energy Center. Earlier reason: The campus has power generation mentioned in state records, but no generating unit, fuel or size is named.

verifications.note: Names Monarch Rock Air, Friday Road, a 1,400 megawatt phased data center and associated power generation.

The Illinois EPA construction permit for the Milkweed Energy Center, issued May 13, 2026 to Monarch Rock Air Gen LLC of 101 Cooper Street, Santa Cruz, California, application 26020005 received February 5, 2026, site number 201030DIR. The location line gives coordinates 42.1526, -89.1186 in Rockford, Winnebago County, 61109. The permit allows construction of twenty 12.37 MWe (12,372 kW) natural gas fired Wartsila non-emergency engine generator sets with selective catalytic reduction and an oxidation catalyst, and caps their combined operation at 130,680 hours a year. The permit pages are scans and the figures were read from the OCR text.

records.researcher_notes: Update of October 30, 2026: the Illinois EPA document library, read in full for this batch, holds a construction permit issued May 13, 2026 to Monarch Rock Air Gen LLC for the Milkweed Energy Center, twenty Wärtsilä natural gas engine generator sets of 12.37 MW each, 247.4 MW, at the coordinates 42.1526, -89.1186 in Rockford. The plant is added in this batch as the Milkweed Energy Center, so this watch item is closed. The earlier search had read only the public notice feed, which does not list this permit. A Rock River Current article from June 2026, based on state incentive records, says Monarch Rock Air plans a multibuilding data center campus with associated power generation on Friday Road in Rockford. It is described as a 1,400 MW phased data center, which is the size of the campus and not of any generator. No source I found names gas engines or turbines. The 250 MW of gas engines mentioned in the earlier task list could not be confirmed, and a Caterpillar order for a site called Monarch belongs to a West Virginia campus. Other reports describe grid power from ComEd. I looked for an Illinois EPA air permit notice and found none. Not found: fuel, number of engines and generating capacity. Check again for an air permit application.

records.plant_name: Edged Chicago data center backup generators (2835 Bilter Road, Aurora)
records.monitor_reason: The permitted backup generator fleet adds up to 45.27 MW, under the 50 MW threshold for a data center backup fleet. A later permit could take it over the line.

verifications.note: The Illinois EPA construction permit 24010010 for Edged Chicago LLC at 2835 Bilter Road, Aurora, issued June 18, 2024, site number 043407AEA. It covers 64 diesel non-emergency generators of 685 kW, G1 to G64, and two diesel emergency generators of 715 kW, G65 and G66. The permit pages are scans and the figures were read from the OCR text.
The Edged Chicago air permit application prepared in October 2023. It names Volvo Penta engines of 625 and 640 kW electrical output for demand response and backup.

records.researcher_notes: Edged Chicago LLC holds an Illinois EPA construction permit for a data center at 2835 Bilter Road in Aurora, DuPage County, next door to the CyrusOne campus at 2725 Bilter Road that is added in this batch. The final permit, number 24010010, was issued on June 18, 2024. It covers 64 diesel non-emergency generators of 685 kW each, numbered G1 to G64, and two diesel emergency generators of 715 kW, G65 and G66. Together they come to 45.27 MW, which is under the 50 MW threshold for adding a backup generator fleet. The application, prepared in October 2023, names the engines as Volvo Penta units of 625 and 640 kW electrical output, used for demand response and backup. The permit is in the Illinois EPA document library under site number 043407AEA; the permit pages are scans and the figures were read from the OCR text. The Edged DeKalb Project Vector campus is a different site and is already in the tracker. Not found: any later permit that adds generators at this site. Check the site's record in the Illinois EPA document library again for a new permit or application.
